findings.title: FALSE auth-js doc claim: handleError does not turn EVERYTHING else into AuthApiError - an AuthUnknownError (non-JSON 5xx/429 body) is classified as a refusal (401), not a transport fault (500)

The terminal 5xx class this diff newly routes into internalError has no emitting Sentry signal and no rule row in beta-launch-alerting.md; a cookie-transport Supabase fault moved 401 -> 500 silently, and no log line distinguishes the bearer transport
Deviation D2 enumerates two cookie-path refusal deltas; the third (cookie Supabase transport fault 401 -> 500) is undeclared, and the gate docblock repeats the same 'two' count
Fragile assertion: invariant #8 is enforced by a regex over SQL template TEXT, which behaviour-preserving reformatting (parenthesisation, alias rename) turns red
The refusal table's ordering is unpinned: no test presents a non-admin AND a non-aal2 together, so moving the role check below the assurance checks would change the refusal code undetected

Intake JWKS claim 'pays no extra fetch' holds only for a cached kid; fetchJwk bypasses the TTL for an unknown kid, costing an uncached JWKS GET plus a getUser fallback per request - an unauthenticated amplification surface once #1185 lets bearers through
Claim 1 is a module contract, not end-to-end: src/proxy.ts branch 4 still gates /api/admin on the cookie session, so no bearer reaches the gate in a deployed environment (declared at plan:293)
